title: St. Ignatius Cathedral, San Ignacio de Velasco

terrainReference.basis: Approximate paving level in front of the mapped cathedral entrance.

mapIdentity.provider: Native OpenStreetMap cathedral outline, plaza entrance node and adjacent named Wikidata identity point, plus the polygon sharing the cathedral’s rear eastern edge.
names: St. Ignatius Cathedral, San Ignacio de Velasco
mapIdentity.scope: The mapped cathedral envelope fixes the plaza front, nave, and the footprint of the adjoining rear volume. The September 2022 public-domain plaza view controls the broad front gable, exterior timber stairs, decorated facade and belfry.

note: The plaza elevation provides relative heights and bay spacing. The tower position behind the left roof slope, building heights, side elevations, rear attachment and individual painted details are reconstructed estimates.
